tool.name: FeatureFinderIdentification
tool.description: Detects features in MS1 data based on peptide identifications
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && mkdir id && cp '$id' 'id/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $id.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($id.ext)' && mkdir out && #if "lib_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir lib_out && #end if #if "chrom_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir chrom_out && #end if #if "candidates_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') mkdir candidates_out && #end if ## advanced options #if $adv_opts.candidates_in: mkdir adv_opts.candidates_in && cp '$adv_opts.candidates_in' 'adv_opts.candidates_in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $adv_opts.candidates_in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($adv_opts.candidates_in.ext)' && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' -id 'id/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $id.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($id.ext)' -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' #if "lib_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -lib_out 'lib_out/output.${gxy2omsext("traml")}' #end if #if "chrom_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -chrom_out 'chrom_out/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' #end if #if "candidates_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') -candidates_out 'candidates_out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' #end if ## advanced options #if $adv_opts.candidates_in: -candidates_in 'adv_opts.candidates_in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $adv_opts.candidates_in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($adv_opts.candidates_in.ext)' #end if
#if len(str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',')) == 0 | tee '$stdout' #end if
## Postprocessing && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' '$out' #if "lib_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'lib_out/output.${gxy2omsext("traml")}' '$lib_out' #end if #if "chrom_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'chrom_out/output.${gxy2omsext("mzml")}' '$chrom_out' #end if #if "candidates_out_FLAG" in str($OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS).split(',') && mv 'candidates_out/output.${gxy2omsext("featurexml")}' '$candidates_out' #end if #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input file: LC-MS raw data
Input file: Peptide identifications derived directly from 'in'
Whether decoy peptides should be quantified (true) or skipped (false)
Minimum score for the best PSM of a spectrum to be used as seed
If for every peptide (or seed) also an offset peptide is extracted (true)
param.help: Can be used to downstream to determine MBR false transfer rates. (0.0 = disabled)

param.name: batch_size
param.label: Nr of peptides used in each batch of chromatogram extraction
param.help: Smaller values decrease memory usage but increase runtime

param.name: mz_window
param.label: m/z window size for chromatogram extraction (unit: ppm if 1 or greater, else Da/Th)

param.name: IM_window
param.label: Ion mobility (IM) window for chromatogram extraction in the IM dimension
param.help: Set to 0.0 to disable IM filtering (even if data contains IM information). The window is applied as +/- IM_window/2 around the median IM value of identified peptides. This parameter is automatically ignored if the input data does not contain IM information (determined via IMTypes::determineIMFormat). Currently only concatenated IM format is supported. Typical values: 0.05-0.10 for TIMS data (1/K0 units), 10-50 for CCS data (square angstroms), 3-5 for FAIMS data (compensation voltage).Note: IM values are calculated per peptide/charge/RT-region, using the median of all identifications in that region for robustness. The median, min, and max IM values are propagated to output features as meta-values (IM_median, IM_min, IM_max) for quality control

param.name: n_isotopes
param.label: Number of isotopes to include in each peptide assay

param.name: isotope_pmin
param.label: Minimum probability for an isotope to be included in the assay for a peptide
param.help: If set, this parameter takes precedence over 'extract:n_isotopes'

param.name: rt_window
param.label: RT window size (in sec.) for chromatogram extraction
param.help: If not set, it is derived from 'detect:peak_width' and 'detect:mapping_tolerance'

section.name: detect
section.title: Parameters for detecting features in extracted ion chromatograms

param.name: peak_width
param.label: Expected elution peak width in seconds, for smoothing (Gauss filter)
param.help: Also determines the RT extration window, unless set explicitly via 'extract:rt_window'

param.name: min_peak_width
param.label: Minimum elution peak width
param.help: Absolute value in seconds if 1 or greater, else relative to 'peak_width'

param.name: signal_to_noise
param.label: Signal-to-noise threshold for OpenSWATH feature detection

param.name: mapping_tolerance
param.label: RT tolerance (plus/minus) for mapping peptide IDs to features
param.help: Absolute value in seconds if 1 or greater, else relative to the RT span of the feature

section.name: model
section.title: Parameters for fitting elution models to features

param.name: type
param.label: Type of elution model to fit to features

param.name: add_zeros
param.label: Add zero-intensity points outside the feature range to constrain the model fit
param.help: This parameter sets the weight given to these points during model fitting; '0' to disable

param.name: unweighted_fit
param.label: Suppress weighting of mass traces according to theoretical intensities when fitting elution models

param.name: no_imputation
param.label: If fitting the elution model fails for a feature, set its intensity to zero instead of imputing a value from the initial intensity estimate

param.name: each_trace
param.label: Fit elution model to each individual mass trace

section.name: check
section.title: Parameters for checking the validity of elution models (and rejecting them if necessary)

param.name: min_area
param.label: Lower bound for the area under the curve of a valid elution model

param.name: boundaries
param.label: Time points corresponding to this fraction of the elution model height have to be within the data region used for model fitting

param.name: width
param.label: Upper limit for acceptable widths of elution models (Gaussian or EGH), expressed in terms of modified (median-based) z-scores
param.help: '0' to disable. Not applied to individual mass traces (parameter 'each_trace')

param.name: asymmetry
param.label: Upper limit for acceptable asymmetry of elution models (EGH only), expressed in terms of modified (median-based) z-scores
param.help: '0' to disable. Not applied to individual mass traces (parameter 'each_trace')

param.name: max_iteration
param.label: Maximum number of iterations for EMG fitting

param.name: init_mom
param.label: Alternative initial parameters for fitting through method of moments

param.name: merge_features
param.label: For FAIMS data with multiple compensation voltages: Merge features that represent the same analyte detected at different CVs
param.help: Features are merged if they have the same charge and are within 5 seconds RT and 0.05 Da m/z. Intensities are summed

param.label: Input file: Feature candidates from a previous run
param.help: If set, only feature filtering and elution model fitting are carried out, if enabled. Many parameters are ignored select featurexml data sets(s)

param.label: Maximum allowed RT deviation (in seconds) between a seed's apex and the detected feature's apex
param.help: Seed-derived features whose detected apex deviates more than this value from the original seed apex are removed during filtering. Useful to discard unreliable seed extractions where the picked peak is far from the seed location. (0 = disabled)

param.label: Overrides tool-specific checks
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

param.name: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS
param.label: Optional outputs
param.option: candidates_out (Output file: Feature candidates (before filtering and model fitting))

data.name: lib_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: lib_out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "lib_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: chrom_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: chrom_out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "chrom_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: candidates_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: candidates_out
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "candidates_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Detects features in MS1 data based on peptide identifications.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_FeatureFinderIdentification.html
